Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calen Loreth: 32-year-old man, 149 cm (very-short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: heart-shaped face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a tiny nose stud; a dense freckle field; a carved belt buckle. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
